decisions.decision: syncStateFrontmatter is the ONLY writer of progress fields
decisions.rationale: Two competing writers (phase.complete phase-weighted vs sync plan-weighted) produced non-deterministic values across consecutive adapter writes. Deriving from disk on every write gives reproducible, always-current results.

decisions.decision: Create-if-missing for additive event dispatchers (decision, metric, blocker_added, todo_count_update)
decisions.rationale: Silent-noop on hardcoded-regex mismatch caused additive writes to be falsely reported as successful. Scaffolding the target section + landing the entry preserves data + signals intent via the future created_section field in the outcome.

decisions.decision: StateWriteOutcome three-state contract DESIGNED (not yet implemented)
decisions.rationale: Even with create-if-missing, callers can't distinguish applied (data landed), intentional no-op (duplicate dedupe), and structural no-op (nothing-to-remove). Shape: {applied: true, created_section?: string} | {applied: false, reason: 'duplicate' | 'nothing_to_remove'}. Design complete in chat history; implementation hit context budget.
